entities.summary: Samvel Mnatsyan was a Russian professional ice hockey defenceman. Throughout his career, he competed in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL), playing for teams such as Barys Astana, HC Neftekhimik Nizhnekamsk, and Admiral Vladivostok.
